# Frontend libraries

- Bootstrap 4.3.1 CSS: copied from STAFF CRM's bundled original theme; MIT, see bootstrap-LICENSE.txt and the source header.
- jQuery 3.7.1: https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.1.min.js; MIT, see jquery-LICENSE.txt.
- DataTables 1.13.8 and Bootstrap 4 adapter: official datatables.net / datatables.net-bs4 npm packages via unpkg; MIT, see datatables-LICENSE.txt.
- Leaflet 1.9.4: official leaflet npm package via unpkg; BSD 2-Clause, see leaflet/LICENSE.

License headers are retained. No other proprietary theme assets are redistributed.
